beats.label: S1 · Orphans of the bridge
beats.text: Vi and Powder lose their parents in a failed Zaunite uprising and are raised by Vander, who preaches restraint toward Piltover's enforcers.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the sisters, their surrogate father, and the Piltover/Zaun fault line every later beat runs on.

beats.label: S1 · The heist that broke everything
beats.text: A botched crystal robbery destroys a Piltover penthouse and forces Vander to negotiate with the enforcers, cracking his authority as his people demand he fight back.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the inciting incident: the crystals fall into the wrong hands and Zaun begins to slip from Vander toward Silco.

beats.label: S1 · Jayce and Viktor invent Hextech
beats.text: Expelled student Jayce partners with Heimerdinger's assistant Viktor to weaponise arcane magic, birthing Hextech under councilor Mel Medarda's patronage.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Hextech, Viktor, and Mel — the technology and people that will define Piltover for every season after.

beats.label: S1 · Powder becomes Silco's
beats.text: A rescue attempt for Vander ends with Powder accidentally killing her brothers; Vi calls her jinx and abandons her, and Silco claims her as his own as Vander dies.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The single hinge of the whole show: the moment Powder is handed to Silco and the sisters' bond is severed.

beats.label: S1 · Years later, cities diverge
beats.text: Piltover thrives on Hextech while Vi rots in Stillwater; Powder is now Jinx, Silco's unstable smuggler, hunted by enforcer Caitlyn after killing six on Progress Day.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Time skip that resets the board — introduces adult Jinx, the Caitlyn who will pull Vi back out, and Piltover's new golden age.

beats.label: S1 · Sisters reunited, sisters split
beats.text: Caitlyn breaks Vi out to hunt Silco; the sisters finally meet but Jinx reads Caitlyn as her replacement, and Firelight leader Ekko snatches the gemstone away.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The reunion doesn't heal the wound — it deepens it, and introduces Ekko as the third pole in Zaun's fight.

beats.label: S1 · Jinx chooses her father, then kills him
beats.text: Piltover offers Zaun independence in exchange for Jinx; she overhears, breaks down and accidentally shoots Silco dead, then embraces her name and rockets the Council.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's final domino: Silco dies, Jinx crosses over, and the war Zaun couldn't win in the streets begins on her terms.

cliffhanger.text: Jinx has fired a Hextech rocket at Piltover's Council chamber in the same minute they voted to grant Zaun its independence. Silco is dead in her arms and nobody watching yet knows who in that chamber survived.
questions: Who at the Council table lived through the strike?
With Silco gone, who takes Zaun?
Can Vi still reach Powder, or is Jinx all that's left?

characters.name: Vi
characters.line: The elder sister — freshly out of Stillwater, allied with Caitlyn against Silco, and just watched Jinx murder him and fire on Piltover.

characters.name: Powder / Jinx
characters.line: Vi's younger sister and Silco's ward, unstable since childhood; has just killed the father-figure who chose her over Zaun and fully claimed the name Jinx.

characters.name: Silco
characters.line: Zaun's crime lord and Jinx's surrogate father; killed by her at the exact moment he chose her over the independence he'd spent his life fighting for.

characters.name: Caitlyn Kiramman
characters.line: Piltover enforcer and Kiramman heiress who freed Vi to catch Silco; wounded and back in Piltover just as Jinx's rocket hits the Council chamber where her mother sits.

characters.name: Jayce Talis
characters.line: Inventor of Hextech and freshly seated councilor; blockaded Zaun and personally killed a child worker during a raid on Silco's shimmer factories with Vi.

characters.name: Viktor
characters.line: Jayce's brilliant partner, dying of a wasting illness and secretly using the Hexcore and Singed's shimmer on himself; guilt-stricken after accidentally killing his friend Sky.

characters.name: Ekko
characters.line: Childhood friend of Vi and Powder, now leader of the Firelights fighting Silco; walked away from Jinx and returned the recovered gemstone toward Piltover.

characters.name: Mel Medarda
characters.line: Noxian-born councilor and Jayce's patron and lover; the political architect of Hextech's rise, seated at the Council when the rocket strikes.

characters.name: Ambessa Medarda
characters.line: Mel's mother and a Noxian warlord, newly arrived in Piltover to steel the city for war against Zaun.

characters.name: Heimerdinger
characters.line: The ancient yordle professor whom Jayce forced off the Council; now exiled, wandering Zaun and just met by Ekko.

beats.label: S2 · Rocket aftermath
beats.text: Half the Council dies in Jinx's strike, including Caitlyn's mother Cassandra; Jayce breaks his word and fuses the Hexcore into a dying Viktor to save him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Caitlyn's grief-fuelled war and, more importantly, plants the Hexcore inside Viktor's body — the seed of everything that follows.

beats.label: S2 · Caitlyn's task force and Ambessa's coup
beats.text: Caitlyn's Hextech squad hunts Jinx with Vi at her side; the raid ruptures Zaun's air ducts, poisons Piltover, and Ambessa uses the crisis to take command under martial law.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Aggression drives Vi off, Piltover's government falls to Noxus, and Zaun is now occupied — the political shape of the whole rest of the season.

beats.label: S2 · Viktor's cult and Jinx's ward
beats.text: Viktor wakes changed, heals shimmer addicts and gathers a Zaunite following; Jinx adopts the orphan Isha and, revered as the face of the revolt, is pulled back toward war.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Viktor becomes a messiah, Jinx becomes a folk hero, and Isha becomes the tether that later breaks her.

beats.label: S2 · Vander returns as a monster
beats.text: Singed's human-wolf hybrid is revealed to be a resurrected Vander; the sisters recognise their father and bring him to Viktor's sanctuary to be healed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Vi and Jinx briefly back on the same side and sets up the collision at the sanctuary that ends most of the season's arcs.

beats.label: S2 · Doors open to other worlds
beats.text: A wild rune hurls Jayce into a future where Viktor destroys Piltover and Ekko into a universe where Powder never fell; Jayce returns and stabs Viktor at the sanctuary.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Redefines Viktor as an existential threat and gives Jayce the motive to kill him — the pivot from cold war to open war.

beats.label: S2 · Losses and reconciliations
beats.text: Isha blows herself up to save Jinx from a reawakened Vander; Jinx is jailed, Vi and Caitlyn reconcile, and Mel escapes a Black Rose prison having awakened her own magic.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Clears the emotional board before the finale: Jinx broken, the couple back together, and Mel now a mage in her own right.

beats.label: S2 · The last stand at the Hexgate
beats.text: Viktor and Ambessa strike Piltover for the wild rune; Ekko frees Jayce and the two vanish destroying it, Ambessa dies to a Black Rose sorceress, and Jinx sacrifices herself to save Vi from Vander.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The end-state the reader is walking back into: Jayce, Viktor, Ambessa and Jinx all gone, and the survivors left to build whatever comes next.

cliffhanger.text: The war is over and most of its main players are gone. Jayce and Viktor have vanished destroying the wild rune, Ambessa is dead, Jinx has seemingly killed herself saving Vi from Vander, and the survivors — Vi, Caitlyn, Sevika, Mel, Ekko — are left to build whatever comes next.
questions: Did Jinx actually die under that collapse, and can Vi live with losing her again?
What does the Black Rose do now that Ambessa is dead and Mel has awakened her own magic?
Can Piltover and Zaun, with Sevika on the Council, actually share a city?

characters.name: Vi
characters.line: Survived the war and mourns Jinx; now considering a life with Caitlyn instead of another fight.

characters.name: Caitlyn Kiramman
characters.line: Lost her mother in the rocket strike, briefly served Ambessa's martial law, and ended the season commanding Piltover's enforcers with Vi at her side.

characters.name: Jinx
characters.line: Fought her way through the war a Zaunite folk hero, lost her adoptive daughter Isha, and seemingly blew herself up saving Vi from a feral Vander.

characters.name: Mel Medarda
characters.line: Councilor turned awakened Black Rose–born mage after her captivity; has left Piltover for Noxus to face whatever her mother's death opens up.

characters.name: Ambessa Medarda
characters.line: Noxian warlord who engineered Piltover's martial law and occupation of Zaun; killed at the Hexgate by a Black Rose sorceress.

characters.name: Sevika
characters.line: Silco's former lieutenant and the last Chem-Baron standing; now Zaun's first representative on the Piltover Council.

characters.name: Jayce Talis
characters.line: Killed Viktor once and then, after glimpsing the future Viktor built, vanished with him destroying the wild rune.

characters.name: Viktor
characters.line: Transcended into a magical being trying to remake humanity through the Hexcore; vanished with Jayce as they destroyed the wild rune together.

characters.name: Ekko
characters.line: Firelight leader who returned from a parallel universe where Powder never fell, and used his time-reversal device to break Viktor's hold on Jayce in the finale.

characters.name: Vander
characters.line: The sisters' adoptive father, brought back by Singed as a feral human-wolf hybrid; his rampage in the final battle is what forces Jinx's sacrifice.
